Qui vedi quante informazioni passano dal: Here you see how much information passes from the cells to the shared space, and how often two cells say different things. When that happens, a curator decides who is right.
Qui vedi quanti documenti il server sta: Here you see how many documents the server is reading and how many are waiting in line. If the line keeps growing and never goes down, the server needs more help.
Qui vedi quanto tempo ci mette il server: Here you see how long the server takes to find things. The lower the line, the faster. A search already done is very fast, because the server remembers it.
Qui vedi se la memoria è in ordine: coll: Here you see if the memory is in order: links that lead nowhere, sheets nobody uses, things that contradict each other. It is like checking that the books are in the right place.

Un team è un gruppo di persone, per esem: A team is a group of people, for example an office. If you give the team a permission, all its members have it. A person can be in more than one team. When a person leaves the company, their work sheets go to their team; their personal sheets are deleted.
Un vault è una scatola dove si mettono i: A vault is a box where you put sheets. A cell is the box of a person or a group. A hive space is a big box that everyone shares: every night it takes the important things from the small linked boxes. Press «Edit» to change a box. A restore point is a photo of the box: if something goes wrong, you bring it back to how it was.
Una cella per ogni persona, gruppo o pro: One cell for each person, group or project; hive spaces collect the shared information of the linked cells. Each vault has its own search partition.
Una copia delle pagine del vault in ques: A copy of the vault pages at this moment. Restoring brings all pages back to that copy. The server saves one by itself before an import and before a restore.
